data.title: 若叶睦 · 菜园里的黄瓜
data.description: 藤蔓上结出的黄瓜已经够长了。睦轻轻拨开叶子，将它摘下放进篮子，又给旁边的小苗浇了水。
data.promptProse: Mutsumi stands amidst a verdant vegetable patch, quietly holding a freshly clipped, prickly green cucumber in both hands. Behind her, sprawling cucumber vines climb a bamboo trellis dotted with yellow blossoms, while a woven wicker basket rests on damp morning soil.
data.animaCaption: Holding the freshly harvested cucumber with careful two-handed reverence, she inspects its crisp green skin under the morning sun.
